required_documents.name: SF424 (R&R) Cover Form
required_documents.details: Standard application cover sheet including applicant small business UEI and active award references.

required_documents.name: Project Summary / Abstract
required_documents.details: Succinct summary of late-stage development and commercialization activities. Maximum 30 lines of text.
required_documents.source: PAR-27-098-Revised-Full-Announcement.html Section IV.2 SF424(R&R) Other Project Information

required_documents.name: Project Narrative
required_documents.details: Two or three sentences describing public health impact and commercial application.
required_documents.source: PAR-27-098-Revised-Full-Announcement.html Section IV.2 SF424(R&R) Other Project Information

required_documents.name: R&R Senior/Key Person Profile
required_documents.details: Biographical sketches of key commercialization personnel, regulatory consultants, and investigators (max 5 pages each).
required_documents.source: PAR-27-098-Revised-Full-Announcement.html Section IV.2 Senior/Key Person Profile

required_documents.name: R&R Budget and Justification
required_documents.details: Detailed line-item budget covering technical assistance, regulatory consulting, IP filing, and clinical trial preparation.

required_documents.name: Specific Aims
required_documents.details: One page outlining commercialization readiness goals and milestones.
required_documents.source: PAR-27-098-Revised-Full-Announcement.html Section IV.2 PHS 398 Research Plan

required_documents.name: Commercialization Readiness Plan (Research Strategy)
required_documents.details: Maximum 12 pages outlining commercialization strategy, regulatory pathway, intellectual property landscape, and market adoption.

required_documents.name: Letters of Support from Partners and Investors
required_documents.details: Letters from strategic corporate partners, regulatory advisors, or follow-on investors endorsing the commercialization path.
required_documents.source: PAR-27-098-Revised-Full-Announcement.html Section IV.2 PHS 398 Research Plan

required_documents.name: eRA Commons and SAM.gov Registrations
required_documents.details: Active SAM.gov registration with UEI and eRA Commons company and PD/PI credentials.

deadlines.when: September 5, 2026, 5:00 p.m. local time of applicant organization
January 5, 2027, 5:00 p.m. local time of applicant organization
April 5, 2027, 5:00 p.m. local time of applicant organization

eligibility.summary: Only United States small business concerns (SBCs) that have had an active NIH SBIR or STTR Phase II or Phase IIB award within the last 36 months are eligible. In North Carolina, small life science and health tech businesses that have completed NIH Phase II awards qualify.

cost_share.details: This NOFO does not require cost sharing as defined in the NIH Grants Policy Statement.

review_criteria.weight: Scored 1-9 (core criterion focusing on commercial viability)

submission_limits: Only one CRP award is allowed per project.
important_notes: Applicants must cite their qualifying prior or active NIH Phase II or Phase IIB grant or contract number.
Funding is restricted to late-stage R&D and commercialization readiness activities not supported by regular SBIR awards.
Applications without an active Phase II / IIB within 36 months will be withdrawn without review.
